description.value: The Tree Hugger Smoothie & Juice Bar is a juice-focused fast-food spot located in the Fraser Valley region of BC. Specializing in smoothies and juice bowls, it offers a refreshing stop for cyclists passing through the area. Its focus on fresh, plant-based drinks makes it a natural fit for health-conscious touring riders.
